title: 強調の記号
description: 感嘆符・チェック・バツ・キラキラ・集中線。画面の一点を強めるための記号です。そのまま重ねられる透過PNGです。
creator: @fuuuuuuma

tone.light: 均一。影を落とさない（重ねたときに浮かないため）
tone.colorTemp: 彩度の高い1色。黄・赤・白・黒の4系統
tone.framing: 正方形の中央に1つ。余白を均等に取る
tone.texture: 太い輪郭のフラットな塗り。手描きのゆがみを少し残す

pieces.prompt: a single bold exclamation mark, thick flat bright yellow fill with a thick black outline, slightly tilted, centered on a plain flat solid magenta background, no other objects, high contrast between the mark and the background

a single bold question mark, thick flat white fill with a thick black outline, slightly tilted, centered on a plain flat solid magenta background, no other objects, high contrast between the mark and the background

a bold hand-drawn cross mark made of two thick strokes, bright red, centered on a plain flat solid magenta background, no other objects, high contrast between the mark and the background

a scatter of five four-pointed sparkle stars of different sizes, flat bright yellow fill with a thin black outline, centered on a plain flat solid magenta background, no other objects, high contrast between the sparkles and the background

a burst of radiating straight speed lines forming a ring with an empty center, thin black lines of varying length, centered on a plain flat solid magenta background, no other objects, high contrast between the lines and the background

three short curved motion lines suggesting shaking, thick black strokes, arranged in a fan, centered on a plain flat solid magenta background, no other objects, high contrast between the lines and the background
